entries.en: of long standing; ancient; for a long time (much tiempo)
in past years, days and times; long ago
in days gone by; of old

entries.zh: 早时；古时〔M 栏多出“存”(?)音节，污损难辨〕
entries.en: in early/ancient times; formerly
entries.notes: 西语 tha tiempo 疑为 hace tiempo 之污损；M 栏四音节与 H 两字不合，T99 污损

entries.zh: 清晨；一大早〔“惇”字疑为“晨”之误写〕
entries.en: early morning; at daybreak (entero tiempo: the whole/early time)
entries.notes: source_H 自标疑字（惇/晨），M 栏含 T99

entries.en: most ancient; at the very beginning (al principio)
entries.notes: M 栏五音节与 H 三字（当元初）对位存疑，含 T99；西语 antiguissim.（最高级）+ al principio

entries.en: originally; at first (antiguo origen)
at first; origin; beginning (antigua menze ≈ antigua vez/origen)
entries.notes: 西语 menze 为非常见词形（或 vez/mese 之讹），展开依赖推断；M 栏含 T99

entries.en: at the beginning; at first (al principio)

entries.zh: 原早时；如亚当时代之初（原初混沌/太初）
entries.en: as in the time of Adam at first; in primeval times
entries.notes: source_H 自标疑字（惇/晨）；西语 2a Adan 语境指太古之初

entries.en: since the beginning; from of old
originally; ancient (antiguamente)
originally; formerly (antiguamente)
as of old; original and old (antiguamente)
very early; early on (antiguamente)
highest antiquity; remote antiquity (antiquísimamente)

entries.zh: 寿山（南山之寿）；长寿〔M 栏多出二音节，疑为“龟 age”类释义语，污损〕
entries.en: long life; longevity (larga edad); the Mount Shou metaphor for long life
entries.notes: H 二字与 M 四音节不合，M 栏多出 gūĩ cai 两音节 T99 污损，或系原稿另加注语

entries.en: eyeglasses; spectacles (ante los ojos)
entries.notes: 西语 A X ojos 疑为 ante los ojos 之缩讹；目镜即眼镜，马尼拉贸易常见之物

entries.zh: 孕妇口馋（妊娠恶阻之嗜食）〔“病口”为直译〕
entries.en: the craving (antojo) of a pregnant woman; morning-sickness appetite
entries.notes: antojo de preñada 为17世纪西语固定义（孕妇之馋）；汉字“病口”与音写对位偏移，含 T99

entries.zh: 僻（对任何事物之怪嗜、偏嗜）
entries.en: a capricious craving for any thing; whim; odd liking
entries.notes: R 栏 T99 污损；僻字单用表偏嗜，义合 antojo de cualquier cosa

entries.en: a whim or capricious inclination; odd disposition
entries.notes: M 栏混入西语 inclination 一词，原稿即双语并注；R 栏含 T99

entries.zh: 结；系结（裸体袒结之义待考）
entries.en: to tie; knot (A Nudas - related sense uncertain)
entries.notes: 西语 A Nudas 语义无法定夺；M 栏四音节（car gīn gua car）与 H 单字对位不明
